frozen_acceptance.interpretation: Operational acceptance chosen before new outcomes; failures remain failures. These thresholds are not claims from the source paper. Region convergence requires all three spatial criteria for the compared pair. Reaching a terminal box is finite-time reach-avoid evidence, not an invariance proof.

scope: Diagnose quadrature, target sampling and LF control dissipation. No physical targets or thresholds change.
intervention: Exact concave Godunov control flux; same ENO3, float64, RK3, CFL, prepared fields, grid and horizon.
next_stage: If effective, verify all 18 original case families with unchanged criteria; refine grid where necessary. Retain unsuccessful comparisons.

geometry_intervention.description: Keep the exact MATLAB target parameters, dynamics and constraints; anchor quiet-standing equilibrium on the uniform grid. Compare the same original tolerances.

godunov_value_floor: Each RK stage >= min(initial); numerical lower bound for sampled initial costs, not an accuracy bound for the continuous physical goal.
